title: Commercially usable labeled invoice and logistics datasets — official links
selection_rule: Explicit commercial permission for the specified data scope; conditions remain source-specific. No guarantee of all possible third-party rights.

datasets.name: AI Hub OCR — Finance & Logistics
datasets.scale_en: Real logistics documents; CI 26,044, PL 27,388, B/L 26,541, C/O 11,137
datasets.labels_en: OCR polygons and transcription; linked line-item gold unverified
datasets.labels_ko: OCR 폴리곤·전사; 품목행 연결 정답 미확인
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Commercial AI training/results allowed with source credit. Raw/simple-processed redistribution prohibited. Application approval required; overseas use/transfer requires separate agreement.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 출처를 표시하고 AI 학습·모델·서비스 결과물을 상업 활용할 수 있음. 원본·단순 가공본 재배포 금지. 신청·승인 필요; 국외 이용·반출은 별도 합의 필요.
datasets.scope_notes_en: The detailed logistics table totals 107,918 images; the overview says 107,919. Financial documents are a separate 50,000 images. Do not treat OCR labels as semantic item fields. Applications are limited to Korean nationals.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 물류 상세표 합계 107,918장과 개요 107,919장에 1장 차이가 있음. 금융 50,000장은 별도. OCR 라벨을 의미 필드·품목행 정답으로 해석하지 않음. 내국인 신청 제한.
datasets.attribution: AI Hub / National Information Society Agency

datasets.name: Company Documents v2
datasets.scale_ko: 합성 PDF 353,580개 중 인보이스 48,158개; 가상 회사 60곳
datasets.labels_en: Header and items[] JSON; field/word coordinates
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Preserve Apache license/NOTICE and seed-source MIT/BSD notices; identify modifications.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: Apache 라이선스·NOTICE와 seed 데이터의 MIT/BSD 고지를 보존하고 변경 사실을 표시.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Includes invoice, packing slip, shipping order and purchase order subsets. Page counts and degraded variants are not additional independent transactions.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 인보이스·packing slip·shipping order·purchase order 하위셋 포함. 페이지 수·훼손 변형을 독립 거래 수로 더하지 않음.
datasets.attribution: Cherguelaine Ayoub (2026), Company Documents v2: Synthetic Business Documents

datasets.name: Invoice Extraction Benchmark v1 — DrewKraken
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the data creators, link CC BY 4.0 and mark modifications; code has a separate MIT license.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 데이터 저작자·출처·CC BY 4.0 링크 및 변경 고지. 코드의 MIT 라이선스와 구분.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Freight examples include customs-clearing cases. A useful small benchmark; not a broad sample of real suppliers.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 운임 자료에 통관 수수료 사례 포함. 소규모 기능 평가에 적합하며 실제 거래처 다양성을 대표하지 않음.
datasets.attribution: InvoiceParser Pro, Invoice Extraction Benchmark v1 (2026)

datasets.name: Shopify Invoice Test Pack — SalorWorks
datasets.labels_en: PDF/PNG + expected.json; items, freight, duty, discounts
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the creator, link the source/license and mark modifications.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Edge cases include case packs, free-of-charge items and English/Arabic documents. PDF and PNG of one scenario are the same example.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: case pack·무상 품목·영어/아랍어 문서 등 예외 사례. 동일 시나리오의 PDF와 PNG는 같은 표본.
datasets.attribution: SalorWorks (2026), Synthetic Shopify Invoice Test Pack, version 1.0.0

datasets.name: InvoiceOCR-Synth
datasets.data_license: CC BY 4.0 data; MIT generation code
datasets.labels_en: 32 fields and line_items[]; quantities, prices, taxes
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the creators, link the source/CC BY 4.0 and mark modifications. MIT applies to generation code.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 저작자·출처·CC BY 4.0 링크 및 변경 고지. 생성 코드에는 별도 MIT 적용.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Synthetic business-document mix with six templates. Clean/faded/bad_scan images share underlying records; keep each base document in one evaluation split.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 6개 템플릿의 합성 업무 문서 혼합. clean/faded/bad_scan은 같은 원문 변형이므로 같은 기본 문서를 서로 다른 평가 분할에 넣지 않음.
datasets.attribution: Qazi, Alamgir Munir; Nasir, Jamal Abdul; Chambeth, Pratheesh; Qureshi, Waqar Shahid (2026). InvoiceOCR-Synth: An annotation-noise-free synthetic dataset of receipt and invoice images for document information extraction. Hugging Face. DOI: 10.57967/hf/9733.

datasets.name: KatanaML invoices-donut-data-v1
datasets.data_license: MIT processing + CC BY 4.0 source documents
datasets.scale_en: 501 split records: train 425 / test 26 / validation 50; card says 500
datasets.scale_ko: 분할 합계 501건: train 425 / test 26 / validation 50; 카드 설명 500건
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Preserve both Katana MIT notices and the original Mendeley CC BY 4.0 attribution/conditions.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: Katana 가공본 MIT와 Mendeley 원본 CC BY 4.0 출처·조건을 함께 보존.
datasets.scope_notes_en: The processing license does not remove the original-document license. The published card and split count disagree.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 가공본 라이선스가 원본 문서 조건을 제거하지 않음. 카드 설명과 공개 분할 수가 불일치.
datasets.attribution: Katana ML team; Kozłowski, Marek & Weichbroth, Paweł (2021), Samples of electronic invoices, Mendeley Data V2, DOI: 10.17632/tnj49gpmtz.2

datasets.name: Sinabis synthetic PDF family
datasets.labels_en: Metadata/header fields and text; line-item gold unverified
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the creator, link the source/license and mark modifications; verify the card of the selected size/version.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 저작자·출처·라이선스 링크 및 변경 고지. 선택한 크기·버전의 카드를 확인.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Includes 1K/10K/100K/1M variants. Do not add variant counts as unique documents. PDF archives and metadata Parquet serve different purposes.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 1K/10K/100K/1M 크기 변형은 독립 문서 수로 합산하지 않음. PDF와 메타데이터 Parquet를 구분.
datasets.attribution: Sinabis GmbH (2026). Sinabis Green Energy – Synthetic Document Dataset (1M PDFs). https://huggingface.co/datasets/sinabis-group/sinabis-1m-synthetic-pdf

datasets.name: ExtractBench Pro — synthetic subset only
datasets.scale_ko: 합성 문서 100개; 여러 문서 유형 혼합
datasets.labels_en: JSON schemas and expected outputs; repeated arrays where applicable
datasets.labels_ko: JSON 스키마·expected output; 문서에 따라 반복 배열
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Preserve Apache license/NOTICE and modification notices. Scope here is the synthetic Pro release only.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: Apache 라이선스·NOTICE·변경 고지 보존. 이 목록의 범위는 합성 Pro 판본으로 한정.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Not 100 invoices. The separate base release contains real public documents and is outside this catalogue’s approved scope.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 100개 전부 인보이스가 아님. 실제 공개 문서가 포함된 별도 기본판은 이 목록의 확인 범위에서 제외.
datasets.attribution: Boyang Zhang, Adrian Lyjak, Eli Stewart, Zhaoqi Li, Simon Suo (2026), ExtractBench

datasets.name: FATURA2
datasets.labels_en: Header fields, text/bboxes and whole-TABLE regions
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Use the Zenodo dataset license; credit the source/license and mark modifications.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: Zenodo 데이터 라이선스 기준으로 출처·라이선스·변경 고지.
datasets.scope_notes_en: A table-region annotation is not item/cell-level gold. White/colored backgrounds are variants; the paper’s license is distinct from the dataset license.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: TABLE 영역 라벨은 품목·셀 단위 정답이 아님. 흰색·컬러 배경은 변형본. 논문과 데이터 라이선스를 구분.
datasets.attribution: Limam, Mahmoud; Dhiaf, Marwa; Kessentini, Yousri. FATURA Dataset. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.10371464

datasets.name: MIDD
datasets.scale_en: 630 source invoices / 4 layouts; public release is IOB text
datasets.scale_ko: 원천 인보이스 630개 / 4개 레이아웃; 공개본은 IOB 텍스트
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the source/license and mark modifications; scope is the published IOB text and annotations.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 출처·라이선스·변경 고지. 공개 IOB 텍스트·주석 범위에 한정.
datasets.scope_notes_en: The public IOB.rar does not provide the original invoice images or linked item rows.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 공개 IOB.rar에는 원본 이미지 및 연결된 품목행 정답이 제공되지 않음.
datasets.attribution: Dipali Baviskar; Swati Ahirrao; Ketan Kotecha. Multi-layout Invoice Document Dataset (MIDD). DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.5113009

datasets.name: InvoicesReceiptsPT
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Follow the original Zenodo CC BY 4.0 attribution/conditions even if a repackaged card shows Apache.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 재포장 카드의 Apache 표기와 별개로 원본 Zenodo의 CC BY 4.0 출처·조건 준수.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Two original releases are linked. Header labels do not include complete item-row gold.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 원본 배포 2개를 연결. 헤더 라벨이며 전체 품목행 정답은 없음.
datasets.attribution: Cruz, Francisco; Castelli, Mauro. Dataset of invoices and receipts including annotation of relevant fields (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.6371710); Dataset of personal invoices and receipts including annotation of relevant fields (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7213544)

datasets.name: jngb-labs/InvoiceBenchmark
datasets.labels_en: Tax, subtotal, discount, total and intentional-error ground truth
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Preserve copyright and MIT license notices.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Best treated as an amount-validation benchmark, not a claim of complete line-item extraction labels.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 금액 검증 벤치마크로 활용. 전체 품목행 추출 정답이 완비된 것으로 해석하지 않음.
datasets.attribution: Jakob Neugebauer (2026), InvoiceBenchmark: A Controlled Corpus for Measuring LLM Invoice Processing Accuracy; jngb-labs

datasets.name: Invoice Parsing — Mendeley
datasets.scale_en: Described as based on 800 invoices; public release has post-OCR files
datasets.scale_ko: 800개 인보이스 기반이라고 설명; 공개본은 OCR 후처리 파일
datasets.labels_en: Input text and Gemini-generated structured output
datasets.labels_ko: 입력 텍스트와 Gemini 생성 구조화 출력
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the source/license and mark modifications; scope is files actually attached to the official record.
datasets.commercial_conditions_ko: 출처·라이선스·변경 고지. 공식 레코드에 실제 첨부된 파일만 해당.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Public root files are two XLSX, one JSON and one TXT; no images were attached. Machine-generated outputs are not verified human gold.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 확인한 공개 루트 파일은 XLSX 2개·JSON 1개·TXT 1개이며 이미지 미첨부. 기계 출력을 사람이 검수한 정답으로 간주하지 않음.
datasets.attribution: Aldo Junaidi Pebry; Emny Yossy (2026), Invoice Parsing, Mendeley Data V1. DOI: 10.17632/dcbshwmfct.1

datasets.name: CORD v2
datasets.labels_en: Text/bboxes, semantic fields, grouped menu/item rows and gt_parse
datasets.commercial_conditions_en: Credit the creators, link the source/license and mark modifications.
datasets.scope_notes_en: Retail receipts are an adjacent domain, not customs invoices. This entry covers the public 1,000-document subset, not the full research corpus.
datasets.scope_notes_ko: 소매 영수증 보조 자료이며 통관 인보이스가 아님. 논문의 전체 코퍼스가 아닌 공개 1,000개 하위셋만 해당.
datasets.attribution: Seunghyun Park, Seung Shin, Bado Lee, Junyeop Lee, Jaeheung Surh, Minjoon Seo, Hwalsuk Lee (2019). CORD: A Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing. NAVER CLOVA.
